chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
One of the two Imams, peace be upon them, said:

When you purchase goods, then magnify Allah three times, then say: O Allah, I have purchased it seeking from Your goodness therein, so place goodness for me in it. O Allah, I have purchased it seeking from Your bounty therein, so place bounty for me in it. O Allah, I have purchased it seeking from Your provision therein, so place provision for me in it.
Then repeat each one of them three times.
ai.seo_question: What du'a should be recited when buying goods for trade?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a du'a to be recited when purchasing merchandise, linking trade and livelihood to remembrance of Allah. It emphasizes seeking goodness, bounty, and provision from Allah in one's transactions and repeating the supplication with care.
